item.description:

Now is the Time to Register for Youth Fall Soccer Leagues!

Registration is quickly closing for fall youth soccer leagues. The 12-game league features six games in fall and six games in spring. Fall games will start the week of Sept. 16. The league fee also includes a uniform (jersey, shorts and socks) and officials for Pee Wee, Juniors and Seniors divisions. Don't wait, registration closes when leagues are full or Aug. 6.

Explore league fees and other important information.

Columbus Recreation and Parks believes all kids deserve the chance to play regardless of ability to pay. Financially-challenged families with can apply for a PLAY Scholarship to help reduce the fee for the league. Explore requirements and eligibility online.

item.title: Join Us for Crew Community Day on Friday, July 21
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Join Us for Crew Community Day on July 21

On Friday July 21, from 5-8 p.m., join our Crew at Lower.com Field for Community Day, presented by Molina Healthcare:

  • From 6-8 p.m., all youth are invited to participate in Soccer Free Play on the Pitch!
  • Youth in attendance will receive a World Cup t-shirt (while supplies last)
  • Free kids meals available for youth participants
  • Enjoy our Community Resource Fair along with Additional Fun Family Activities
  • Meet Crew Cat and SC
  • Stick around for the USWNT watch party in The Pub after Community Day

Interested in your child participating in the free play on the pitch? Register today!

item.title: Updates for Winter Programming
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Updates for Winter Programming

Due to the recent increase in COVID-19 cases, Columbus Recreation and Parks Department is taking steps to ensure the health and safety of our participants and staff. Updates to our programs are outlined below:

Columbus Aquatics Center - Youth and adult swim lessons, stroke clinic and dive clinics are postponed one week to start the week of Jan. 10. Water aerobics, open swim and lap swim will go on as scheduled. Winter 2 classes registration opened yesterday and will start Jan. 31.

Community Centers - Winter Session classes will now start the week of Jan. 18. Registration will still open today, Jan. 4 at 12:30 p.m. To help limit direct contact with the public, we are asking participants to register online. In-person registrations can still be completed, but please stay home if you are sick or have any symptoms of COVID-19.

Cultural Arts Center - Session 1 classes will continue as planned. 

Fitness Resolution Solution - This event is being postponed. A new date will be announced soon.

Youth Basketball Leagues - League play will be postponed one week and will have new precautions; more detailed information will be sent directly to coaches, parents and guardians. Please check with your center for specific information and league schedules.
